End-to-End Workflow

Convenience wrappers that produce all standard outputs (analysis, figures, tables) from simulation results in one call.

medsim_workflow()
Generate analysis, figures, and tables from simulation results
medsim_figures()
Generate all standard figures from simulation results
medsim_tables()
Generate all standard LaTeX tables from simulation results

Simulation Scenarios

Functions for defining and validating simulation scenarios with ground truth parameters, and the estimand-kind descriptor used by downstream analysis commands.

medsim_estimand()
Declare the estimand kind for a simulation scenario
medsim_scenario()
Create Custom Simulation Scenario

medsim_validate_scenario()
Validate Scenario

Numeric Accuracy Scenarios

Scenario factory for numerical accuracy and timing studies (e.g., the product-of-three CI comparison). Uses estimand$kind = "numeric" — no DGM, no coverage/power analysis; only error, abs_error, elapsed_sec result columns and timing tables.

medsim_scenario_numeric()
Create a numeric accuracy simulation scenario

P_med Probabilistic Mediation (pmed)

Scenario factory and MBCO estimator adapter for the P_med probabilistic estimand P(Y1 > Y0) + 0.5·P(Y1 == Y0). Uses estimand$kind = "probabilistic" so medsim_analyze_coverage() dispatches the MBCO-CI coverage branch. Ground truth is computed via a cross-world potential-outcome draw at scenario construction time.

medsim_scenario_pmed()
Create a P_med simulation scenario
medsim_method_pmed_mbco()
MBCO confidence interval for P_med (two-branch method)

Differential-Misclassification Bounds (DM)

Scenario factory and estimator adapter for partial-identification bounds studies (me-mediator-bounds / me-exposure-recall). Uses the interval-kind estimand so that medsim_analyze_coverage() dispatches the Imbens-Manski / partial-ID coverage branch automatically. Requires medrobust (Suggests); synthetic fallback used when absent.

medsim_scenario_dm()
Construct a differential-misclassification (DM) mediation scenario
medsim_method_bounds()
Bounds estimator adapter for differential-misclassification (DM) studies

Sobol / Functional-ANOVA Variance Share

Scenario factory and estimator adapter for the Sobol variance-share proportion mediated (P_med^sigma2 = V_med/V_T). Uses the variance_share-kind estimand with a closed-form ground truth; the estimator is injected, not vendored.

medsim_scenario_sobol()
Create a Sobol / functional-ANOVA variance-share simulation scenario
medsim_method_sobol()
Sobol / functional-ANOVA variance-share estimator wrapper

Gauge Residual (P_med + W)

Scenario factory and estimator adapter for the gauge-residual estimand (P_med = IIE/OE, W = R/OE). Uses variance_share-kind with exact closed-form corner-mean ground truth; wraps probmed::ward_residual() (analytic or bootstrap percentile CI); estimator is injected, not vendored.

medsim_scenario_gauge()
Create a gauge-residual (P_med + W) simulation scenario
medsim_method_gauge()
Gauge-residual (P_med + W) estimator wrapper

Running Simulations

Core functions for executing Monte Carlo simulations with progress tracking and parallel processing.

medsim_run()
Run Simulation Study
medsim_run_parallel()
Run Tasks in Parallel

Hopper / SLURM Cluster Harness

Pattern for chunked SLURM array jobs on UNM CARC Hopper. Write a submit script, run one chunk per array task, then combine the resulting RDS files – under an integrity audit (rep-id contiguity, collapse signature, seed collisions) – into a single medsim_results object for analysis.

medsim_write_submit_script()
Write a SLURM array submit script for chunked simulation jobs
medsim_run_chunk()
Run one chunk of a chunked SLURM array simulation
medsim_combine_chunks()
Combine chunk RDS files produced by medsim_run_chunk()
medsim_audit_results()
Audit a combined results object for chunked-run integrity violations

medsim_analyze()
Analyze Simulation Results

Analyze Coverage Rates

ADEMP / Performance Reporting

Functions for ADEMP-compliant performance reporting: sizing replications to a target coverage Monte Carlo SE, SE-vs-estimate diagnostics, and full performance summaries (bias, empirical SE, model SE, RMSE + MCSEs). Coverage output from medsim_analyze_coverage() also gains coverage_mcse, n_failed, and failure_rate columns in v0.4.0.

medsim_nsim_for_mcse()
Replications needed for a target coverage Monte Carlo SE
medsim_plot_se_vs_estimate()
Diagnostic scatter of model SE against the point estimate
medsim_analyze_performance()
ADEMP performance summary (bias, SEs, RMSE) with Monte Carlo SEs
medsim_table_performance()
Render a performance summary as a LaTeX table

Missing-Data & Nonnormality (DGM)

Data-generating utilities and missing-data mediation estimator adapters for simulations under missingness and nonnormality (the Missing Effect study). medsim_method_mbco_mi() offers own- or fixed-branch ARIV pooling (ariv =) and always emits branch-mixing diagnostics.

medsim_rnonnormal()
Draw nonnormal values with a target marginal skew/kurtosis
medsim_amputate()
Insert missing values under MCAR / MAR / MNAR
medsim_scenario_missing()
Construct a missing-data mediation scenario
medsim_scenario_missing_grid()
Build the full factorial of missing-data scenarios
medsim_method_mbco_mi()
MBCO-MI estimator adapter
medsim_method_mc_ci()
Monte-Carlo CI estimator adapter
medsim_method_ipw()
Thin IPW estimator adapter (robustness appendix)
medsim_summarize_branch_switch()
Summarize the MBCO branch-switch rate per scenario
